from src.data_loading import load_crises, load_cliopatria

matched = result['matched_polity'].notna\(\).sum\(\)
total = len\(result\)
print\(f'Matched {matched}/{total} polities \({100*matched/total:.0f}%\)'\)
print\(result[['Polity.Name','matched_polity','lon','lat']].head\(8\).to_string\(\)\)
")
